name: Teaching
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of teaching in guiding believers and nurturing faith across generations. God promises personal instruction and guidance, as seen in Psalms 32:8, while Proverbs 22:6 highlights the importance of training children in the way they should go to ensure lasting faithfulness. The Great Commission in Matthew 28:19 commands believers to teach all nations, making disciples through baptism and instruction. Additionally, Colossians 3:16 encourages mutual teaching and admonishing within the community, and James 3:1 warns of the serious responsibility and judgment that comes with being a teacher in the faith.
